title: Stop Doing This At Every Red Light (Part 1)
hook: Stop holding your brake pedal down.

script.narration: Stop holding your brake pedal down.
script.visual_search: driver foot pressing car brake pedal traffic light

script.narration: Leaving your foot jammed on the brake at a long red light creates intense pressure in your master cylinder. It also blinds the drivers behind you with glaring red light.
script.visual_search: red brake lights glowing at night traffic

script.narration: Instead, switch to this hidden gear method. Follow so you don't miss Part 2!
script.visual_search: gear shifter hand manual automatic car

description:
Stop making this common daily driving mistake at every traffic light. Learn how to save your brake components and keep your driving smooth.

Subscribe for daily driving tips and tricks to improve your skills on the road.
why_it_will_work: Leverages the high-performing 'Stop doing this' instructional angle that resonates well with the channel's audience.

series.name: Red Light Habits
series.next_part_idea: The correct gear to use during long stops to save your brakes.

quality_problems: fact-check: Holding the brake pedal down does not create 'intense pressure' that damages the master cylinder in normal driving conditions; this is a mechanical exaggeration.; The script references a 'hidden gear method' without explaining it, which is misleading and relies on clickbait tactics prohibited by the rules.
